title: Errors after setting filetype in modeline

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:
Reconstruction can be simplified to:
```sh
filetype=php # may be other filetype with defined syntax
nvim -u NONE -c 'syntax on' <<< $(echo "# vim: ft=$filetype")
```
